FormulaFieldDefinitions.FormulaFieldDefinition: whileprintingrecords; numberVar z :=InStr (totext({CASH_DATA.REC_AMT}),"." ) ; if tonumber(Mid (totext({CASH_DATA.REC_AMT}),z+1 ,2 )) <> 0 then stringVar paise := " and "+ towords(tonumber(Mid (totext({CASH_DATA.REC_AMT}),z+1 ,2 )),0)+" Paise Only" else stringVar paise :=" Only"; stringVar str := Totext (tonumber({CASH_DATA.REC_AMT}),'0.00'); numberVar len1 := length(str); len1; if len1 =9 then ( if tonumber(right(str,8)) <> 0 then towords(tonumber(left(str,1)),0)+" Lacs " + towords(tonumber(right(str,8)),0)+ paise else towords(tonumber(left(str,1)),0)+" Lacs" + paise; ) else if len1 =10 then if tonumber(right(str,8)) <> 0 then towords(tonumber(left(str,2)),0)+" Lacs " +towords(tonumber(right(str,8)),0)+paise ELSE towords(tonumber(left(str,2)),0)+" Lacs " +paise else if len1 =11 then towords(tonumber(left(str,1)),0)+" Crore "+towords(tonumber(right(left(str,3),2)),0)+" Lacs " +towords(tonumber(right(str,8)),0)+paise else if len1 =12 then towords(tonumber(left(str,2)),0)+" Crore "+towords(tonumber(right(left(str,4),2)),0)+" Lacs " +towords(tonumber(right(str,8)),0)+paise else towords(truncate({CASH_DATA.REC_AMT},0),0)+paise
